newsitem.title: USA: Plum Creek Timber to offer units.
newsitem.headline: Plum Creek Timber to offer units.

text.p: Plum Creek Timber Co L.P. said it priced a public offering of 5,100,000 depositary units that represent limited partner interests, at $26.75 a unit.
The company said it plans to use proceeds from the offering to repay part of the bank financing used to help fund the purchase of some Riverwood International Corp assets last week.
Managing underwriters in the offering ar Dean Witter, PaineWebber, Smith Barney and D.A. Davidson. The company also granted underwriters an overallotment option of 765,000 units.
